description:
Gao Zhouhe is a vampire, and he believes he's the last vampire on the earth. Jobless and almost broke, he hasn't paid the rent for three months. One day a lovely girl Kim Shiya moves in and becomes his roommate, and our Mr Dracula instantly falls in love with her, but soon he discovers that there's another guy in her life, and what's more, he seems to be a vampire too...
